variables.name: service
variables.label: Service
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT service_name FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to ORDER BY 1

query.text: SELECT count(*) AS spans FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to AND service_name IN ($service)
SELECT count(*) AS errors FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to AND service_name IN ($service) AND span_status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR'
SELECT max(CAST(timestamp_end AS BIGINT) - CAST(timestamp AS BIGINT)) / 1000000.0 AS slowest FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to AND service_name IN ($service)
SELECT service_name, count(*) AS spans FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to AND service_name IN ($service) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT service_name, count(*) AS errors FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to AND span_status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT service_name, span_status_code AS status, count(*) AS spans FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(date_bin('1 minute'::INTERVAL, timestamp) AS BIGINT) / 1000000 AS minute, service_name, count(*) AS spans FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(timestamp AS BIGINT) / 1000000 AS t, (CAST(timestamp_end AS BIGINT) - CAST(timestamp AS BIGINT)) / 1000000.0 AS duration FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to AND span_kind = 'SPAN_KIND_SERVER' LIMIT 400

SELECT p.service_name AS caller, c.service_name AS callee, count(*) AS calls FROM opentelemetry_traces c JOIN opentelemetry_traces p ON c.trace_id = p.trace_id AND c.parent_span_id = p.span_id WHERE c.timestamp >= $__from AND c.timestamp < $__to AND p.timestamp >= $__from AND p.timestamp < $__to AND p.service_name <> c.service_name GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT service_name, count(*) AS ok, sum(CASE WHEN span_status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 1.35 AS lat, 103.82 AS lon, 120 AS users, 'Singapore' AS city UNION ALL SELECT 51.5, -0.12, 80, 'London' UNION ALL SELECT 37.77, -122.42, 150, 'San Francisco' UNION ALL SELECT -33.87, 151.21, 40, 'Sydney'

SELECT CAST(date_bin('1 minute'::INTERVAL, timestamp) AS BIGINT) / 1000000 AS minute, count(*) AS spans FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT service_name, count(*) AS spans FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT service_name, sum(CASE WHEN span_status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS ok, sum(CASE WHEN span_status_code = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp >= $__from AND timestamp < $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: About this dashboard
panels.content:
# Demo dashboard

Every panel runs a saved query; the **Service** variable above is bound as a parameter.

- Switch tabs, change the service selection, set a refresh interval, compare with the past.
- *Edit* shows the panel queries; *Share* makes a read-only public link.

See [the docs](https://github.com/teochenglim/grepui).
